items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution. No new implementation request or requeue clears the current gates: active measurement windows, failed requests, stranded work, missing execution ownership, incomplete launch-readiness evidence, unavailable operations/security sweeps, and incomplete attribution remain material blockers. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, finance reconciliation, attribution, legal/security evidence, and parked preview-readiness work. Do not deploy, publish, alter DNS, add dependencies or telemetry, spend, expand monetization, or make unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal-lift claims.

The three factory candidates remain parked and private. Continue existing execution-owner verification, preview/build checks, compliance and security evidence, measurement boundaries, rollback points, and explicit blocker documentation. Route implementation only for the first candidate whose gates are fully evidenced; preview-only work must remain isolated and must not publish, deploy, configure analytics, monetize, alter DNS, or spend.

Continue repair-or-close review for failed and cancelled work without retrying unchanged requests. Require dated ownership, root cause, smallest isolated repair, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, attribution, and measurement evidence before any requeue.

Continue existing measurement, finance reconciliation, attribution reconciliation, and legal/security evidence work. Preserve unavailable values as unknown; retain aggregate provider commission as unattributed; keep private launch gates unchanged and keep rights outreach unsent pending required human review and authorization.
